name: Idol of Oak
description: Place into an empty Augment Socket in Boots or a Sceptre to apply its effect to that item. Once socketed it cannot be retrieved but can be replaced by other Augment items.

lines: 15% chance when you gain an Endurance Charge to gain an additional Endurance Charge
If you would gain an Endurance Charge, Allies in your Presence gain that Charge instead
